title: M0: Foundation — project skeleton, error types, config, DB, server
description: Bootstrap the Hookbin project from zero to a running binary that starts an Axum server, connects to SQLite in WAL mode, parses CLI flags, and responds to a health check. Every subsequent milestone depends on this foundation being solid.
goals: cargo build produces a single binary
cargo test passes with foundational tests
Binary starts, binds a port, serves /health
SQLite database initializes with schema in WAL mode
All errors flow through a single AppError type with user-facing suggestions
CLI flags and optional TOML config are parsed

acceptance_criteria.given: a clean checkout of the repo
acceptance_criteria.then: a single `hookbin` binary is produced with zero warnings
the server starts, creates a SQLite database in WAL mode, and responds 200 on GET /health
